pricing: Hardware, one-time purchase in USD from UMEVO's own Shopify store: Note $79 (64GB), Note Plus $109 on sale against a $169 list price (badged '35% off' on a Fall Sale banner whose countdown renders 00:00:00 and states no end date), Note ONE $159 on sale against $179, magnetic case $20, 3-in-1 accessory kit $20, plus a $5 shipping line item. AI minutes depend on which model you buy. Note Plus: Max plan free for year one (unlimited transcription under fair-use terms), then the free Starter plan at 400 transcription minutes a month; from year two that page offers 'Pro $2.50/mo or Max $5.83/mo, billed annually' and minute packs of 120/600/3,000/6,000 minutes at $0.59/$2.59/$10.99/$19.99. Note ONE: 30,000 transcription minutes a month for the first 3 months after activation, then free Starter at 400/month, with Pro $7.99/mo or $69.99/yr (1,800 min/mo), MAX $19.99/mo or $149.99/yr (unlimited) and packs of 120/600/3,000/6,000 minutes at $2.49/$9.49/$44.99/$79.99. The two product pages' ladders do not agree with each other. Minute packs are valid for 2 years; plan minutes reset monthly and free minutes do not carry over. Note ($79) includes no AI plan at all - recording works, transcription follows the companion app's free Starter tier or a paid upgrade. Language count is plan-gated on the Note ONE table: 114 languages on Starter and Pro, 140+ on MAX.
